item.title: Nobel Institute says Venezuelan leader Machado can't give her Peace Prize to Trump
item.description: The organization that oversees the Nobel Peace Prize is throwing cold water on talk of Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado giving her recent award to President Donald Trump.

item.title: Fans celebrate life of Grateful Dead co-founder, guitarist Bob Weir with musical tribute in SF
item.description: At the Grateful Deadhead House in San Francisco, deadheads came to pay homage after learning of Bob Weir's passing. He died after a battle with cancer.

item.title: Maxim Naumov makes US Olympic figure skating team 1 year after parents' tragic death in plane crash
item.description: The U.S. team includes 16 athletes, with notable names like Andrew Torgashev and Maxim Naumov.

item.title: Busy Walnut Creek road reopens to traffic after water main break
item.description: A busy road in Walnut Creek reopened on Saturday after a water main break caused lane closures and traffic backups.

item.title: Remembering John Beam: Celebration of life held for legendary Oakland coach
item.description: A celebration of life was held for legendary Oakland coach John Beam, who tragically died in November. You can watch his celebration here.

item.title: 2026 Golden Globes red carpet fashion | See the photos
item.description: See photos of all the 2026 Golden Globes red carpet looks as the stars celebrate the 83rd annual Golden Globe Awards.

item.title: Brock Purdy, 49ers eliminate defending Super Bowl champion Eagles with 23-19 win in wild-card game
item.description: The San Francisco 49ers beat Philadelphia Eagles 23-19 in the wildcard round of NFL playoffs in Philly on Sunday.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Chilly temperatures inland, Cold Weather Advisory until morning
item.description: Tonight will bring another chill to our inland valleys of the North Bay and East Bay, and a COLD WEATHER ADVISORY will be in effect in those areas from 1 a.m. to 9 a.m. tomorrow.

item.title: Federal Reserve Chair Powell says DOJ has subpoenaed central bank, threatens criminal indictment
item.description: Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell said Sunday the Department of Justice has served the central bank with subpoenas and threatened it with a criminal indictment over his testimony about the Fed's building renovations.

item.title: Off-the-boat Dungeness crab sales begin at SF Fisherman's Wharf for eager buyers
item.description: Bay Area crab lovers rejoice! After weeks of delays, fresh off the boat Dungeness crab sales started Sunday. It's the fourth year crabbers have been selling their catches directly to customers, who can expect to pay $11 per pound.
